name: Minato
source:
Minato is a classmate of [url=/c82594]Satoru[/url] and [url=/c77624]Ayano[/url]. She is one of the first people in the class to meet Ayano when she returns to class. The two girls quickly became friends with many common interests, such as a game on smartphone.

Like many, Minato thinks that Ayano is an "ojousama" and therefore addresses her with respect.
